code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in (1,2,3):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts); c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=color
        fc={1:5,2:8,3:4}[color]
        # Interior checker pattern, with marker count limiting painted cells.
        n=sum(v==fc for row in grid for v in row)
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if ((r-r0-1+c-c0-1)%2==0)]
        for r,c in cells[:n]: out[r][c]=fc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code); exec(code)
ans=transform(grid); print(ans)

code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    fillmap={1:4,2:8,3:5}
    for color,fc in fillmap.items():
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts); c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=color
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                if (r-r0-1+c-c0-1)%2==0: out[r][c]=fc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code); exec(code); ans=transform(grid); print(ans)
